title: New Restaurant Opening: Noodles and Company is Coming to Las Cruces, New Mexico
body_markdown:
# New Restaurant Opening: Noodles and Company is Coming to Las Cruces, New Mexico


Las Cruces, New Mexico is known for its beautiful mountains, scenic views and authentic Mexican cuisine. It is home to areas such as White Sands National Park and attracts hiking enthusiasts who want to explore the breathtaking peaks and indulge in some of New Mexico’s famous green chili. It has everything you could ever want...well except for a Noodles & Company, which is why we decided to make this area our new home. With never-ending options and fresh, made to order dishes, Noodles is here to add and enhance Las Cruces’ rich culinary scene.
“We believe Las Cruces is an ideal community for Noodles & Company, and we’re incredibly excited to officially bring the brand to New Mexico,” said David Lehn, Director of Franchise Operations at Noodles & Company. “With a vibrant and growing community that embraces great food and bold flavors, we’re confident our unique menu and something-for-everyone variety will resonate with Las Cruces guests.”
With every new Noodles & Company restaurant opening, we want to ensure we provide the utmost support and set our teams and franchise partners up for success. Our[newest restaurant](https://locations.noodles.com/nm/las-cruces/3497-northrise-dr) will open Sept. 23 at 3497 Northrise Drive in Las Cruces, marking Noodles & Company’s debut in New Mexico. The restaurant will be operated by our franchise partner, Tsunami Enterprises, LLC, as part of its multi-unit franchise and area development agreement with Noodles & Company. This opening represents an exciting milestone for the brand and establishes a foundation for continued growth throughout the Southwest.


### Convenience Whenever You Need It


We know everyone’s schedules are busy and just keep getting busier. Whether you are a college student at New Mexico State University, a working parent or a teen with a lot of extracurriculars, it can be hard to find time to make healthy meals for yourself and your family.[Noodles & Company](https://noodles.com/menu) is here to help with a wide variety of freshly made, craveable noodle bowls that are perfect for a quick lunch or easy dinner. You don’t have to wait a long time to receive a quality bowl that meets your wellness goals, especially with the new[Protein Packed](https://www.noodles.com/menu/protein-packed) section of our menu. Fast, fresh and sure to cure any craving, Noodles & Company will be there to help!
To make it even more convenient, the[Las Cruces Noodles](https://www.facebook.com/NoodlesandCompanyRinconada) location will have a pick-up window where guests can place[online orders](https://www.noodles.com/order) ahead of time and then pick them without ever leaving the comfort of their car. This feature is only implemented at certain Noodles & Company locations, and we are so pleased that Las Cruces will have it too!


### Bold and Fresh Flavors


While Las Cruces certainly has a vibrant food scene with a plethora of offerings, one of the main desires that residents expressed was wanting more food options readily available to them. Noodles & Company is known for having a diverse and unique menu that ranges from American favorites like the[Creamy Cheddar Mac & Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/mac-cheese/creamy-cheddar-mac-cheese) to Asian classics like the[Japanese Pan Noodles](https://www.noodles.com/menu/noodle-bowls/japanese-pan-noodles) . This wide menu variety is a rarity that will give Las Cruces natives the opportunity to try new cuisines they may not have explored before. Noodles & Company also frequently features new limited time offers, which currently is the[Baked Cheese Tortelloni](https://www.noodles.com/menu/new-featured/baked-cheese-tortelloni) , ensuring that our menu is always innovative and changing for adventurous guests.
Ingredients for each of our original dishes are prepped daily and are ensured to be of the highest quality. Noodles & Company loves to nourish our guests, and we make that mission known by only providing the freshest menu items that satisfy and bring our visitors together.


### New Affordable Option for Las Cruces


Not only is our menu craveable, it also offers plenty of ways to enjoy a satisfying meal at a great value. Our Delicious Duos are a perfect option when you want your favorite noodles as well as a light side to balance it out. Choose any small pasta bowl on our menu, such as[Rigatoni Rosa](https://www.noodles.com/menu/delicious-duos/rigatoni-rosa-with-parmesan-chicken-duo) or[Pulled Pork BBQ Mac & Cheese](https://www.noodles.com/menu/delicious-duos/pulled-pork-bbq-mac-cheese-duo) , and pair it with a side salad, broccoli or even potstickers. Starting at just $9.95, Delicious Duos give you more variety without compromising on flavor. They’re an easy option to grab between classes, on your lunch break or after a long hike.
To make the deals even sweeter, Noodles & Company has our own[Rewards Program](https://www.noodles.com/rewards) ! Guests who place an order of $10 or more before taxes and fees within the first 30 days of having a Rewards account will earn a free Regular Entrée to use on their next visit. Additionally, every order that you place earns points that you can use to redeem Rewards and we always have special offers available for members. We are so delighted to be able to bring a new affordable option to Las Cruces and hope you are so excited to have new guests get to try us for the first time.


### Ready for Any Las Cruces Event


Not only is Noodles & Company equipped to handle groups of all sizes for in-store and to-go orders, we also are available to provide[catering](https://noodles.com/catering) services for any upcoming Las Cruces event! Finding versatile and approachable options can be difficult, especially when throwing a holiday party or hosting a family gathering, but Noodles is here to offer delicious dishes that everyone will enjoy. With packages like the fan favorite[Mac Bar](https://www.noodles.com/catering/mac-bar) and individual pasta pans that feed up to 8 guests, Noodles & Company is sure to be Las Cruces’ new favorite catering option.


### Bringing Expertise to Las Cruces


Noodles & Company has been in business for over 30 years, and we cannot wait to bring that expertise to Las Cruces. Everyone deserves nutritious and comforting options, and we are honored to be able to bring that to the great state of New Mexico. Become a part of our history by being some of our first guests at this new location, we are ready to welcome you with warm hospitality and decadent dishes. We are so excited to become a part of and nourish this great community.
